heading: About Me
biography: I am a passionate Software Engineer who thrives at the intersection of robust engineering systems and intuitive product design. With a rigorous background in Computer Science and hands-on experience across the entire development lifecycle, I enjoy turning complex problem statements into clean, maintainable software.

My journey began with low-level systems programming and evolved into architecting distributed services and reactive web applications. I care deeply about developer experience, clean code principles, accessibility, and high runtime performance.
careerGoals: To design and scale mission-critical software products within high-impact engineering teams, while fostering engineering excellence and inclusive technical mentorship.
